description: GH-44 regression coverage matrix for CharacterGrid. Each requirement names test files and a substring of a test title that must exist in that file.

coordinate placement: runs land on their declared cells
grid bounds: CG-3 and CG-4 reject out-of-bounds runs and row wrap
collision policy: collisions are not resolved by CSS
overflow: CG-7 treats protected overflow as an authoring error
field lengths: field capacity equals its declared length
protected fields: protected values are text, not controls
editable fields: required, invalid, disabled, and read-only states
source order: reflow is opt-in and linearizes runs in source order
focus order: Tab reaches the field, then keys in row-major order
Tab order: Tab and Shift+Tab follow row-major order
Shift+Tab: Tab and Shift+Tab follow row-major order
accessible names: accessible names are their visible text
semantic relationships: the dl group keeps description-list semantics
described by its hint and the message
32x80 integrity: the 3270 profile conforms at 24x80 and at 32x80
320px containment: runs land on their declared cells
text spacing: a full-length field value stays visible
table columns grow so cells never overlap
one-cell track integrity: without overrides every column and row track is exactly one cell
controls fit the row pitch: fields and keys fill exactly one row pitch
table containment: a table run stays inside its declared rows
forced colors: forced colors replace the profile palette
focus not obscured: focus is never hidden by the contained scroller
three-screen reference regression: the three-screen reference workflow conforms in every rendered state
automated accessibility: has no automatically detectable accessibility violations
zero runtime / no 3270 logic in primitiv: canonical HTML patterns contain no executable script
